days.title: Rhine Source and Mountain Peaks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Tomasee lake
stops.detail: From the Oberalppass, a steep climb leads to the source of the Rhine at the Tomasee lake.

stops.name: Pazolastock
stops.detail: The hut is reached from the Oberalp Pass via Pazolastock or from Maighels in two to three hours.

stops.name: Piz Badus
stops.detail: This four-hour ski tour on the Gotthard massif takes you up 2,928-metre Piz Badus before descending more than 1,300 metres via the Maighelshütte to Tschamut.

stops.name: Piz Calmot mountain inn
stops.detail: The Piz Calmot mountain inn is located at the top of the Oberalp Pass at 2,048 meters above sea level, in the immediate vicinity of the source of the Rhine.

days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Val Maighels
stops.detail: After hiking through the wetlands of Val Maighels you start the climb to the Maighelspass and the idyllic Portgerensee lake.

stops.name: Maighels Hut
stops.detail: The circular bike route from Sedrun to the Maighels Hut first leads straight to the source of the Rhine before crossing the Oberalp Pass and returning to Sedrun.
